description: This file is a complete HTML webpage that serves as a mockup for a cart drawer in a Gourmet Delivery web application. It includes static HTML structure, inline CSS styling, and embedded JavaScript for interactive cart functionality such as opening/closing the drawer, updating cart items, and calculating totals.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the cart items and updates subtotal, delivery, and total displays based on current cart contents.

methods.name: updateQty
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific item in the cart and re-renders the cart display.

methods.name: openDrawer
methods.description: Opens the cart drawer by setting the appropriate data attribute and focus.

methods.name: closeDrawer
methods.description: Closes the cart drawer by setting the appropriate data attribute and refocusing the open button.
